psychological_meaning: Rock, with its earthy brown tones, evokes feelings of stability, reliability, and grounding. It is often associated with nature, simplicity, and a sense of comfort. This color can also represent resilience, strength, and a connection to the earth, promoting a feeling of security and dependability.
